checks.label: not up two days in a row

checks.label: linearity of the prior leg

checks.label: young trend: first or second breakout
checks.threshold: prior breakouts since the move started <= 1 (0 for A+)

checks.label: narrow or negative day before
checks.threshold: prior day negative or range < 2.0% (A+: negative and under its 20-session median range)

checks.label: consolidation quality
checks.display: base_sessions=20 breakdowns=0 bursts_in_base=0 giveback=0.31 tightness=0.71 base_volume_vs_leg=0.73 base_volume_vs_avg=0.92
checks.threshold: base 3-20 sessions, breakdowns <= 1, giveback <= 0.34, tightness <= 1.0 (A+: 0 breakdowns, 0 bursts inside, giveback <= 0.25, tightness <= 0.7, base volume under the leg's and the 50-session average)

checks.label: close near the high
checks.threshold: close_pos >= 0.8 and close > open (A+ >= 0.9; partial from 0.7)

checks.label: range expansion
checks.threshold: today's range over the largest of the prior 5 >= 1.0 (A+: also over the prior 10)

checks.label: higher volume
checks.threshold: volume > prior session (A+: rank <= 3 of the last 60); a base over 21 sessions also needs >= 1.5x the 50-session average

notes: extension: close 0.8% vs its 20-SMA, -0.7% over 20 sessions
prior breakouts worked 2 of 4 (closed higher 3 sessions later, last 4 in 60 sessions)

claude.reason: The mechanical grade is A (8.5) but Y is a recorded FAIL — this would be the third breakout of the move in 60 sessions, which Bonde explicitly flags as trend maturity risk. The chart confirms multiple visible pushes out of the rising channel since mid-June, and the base itself is 20 sessions long with tightness just at the A+ boundary (0.71 vs 0.70 threshold), showing several overlapping bars in the shaded region around the 68–70 zone. The signal bar's close position is exactly at the H pass floor (0.80) and volume is only marginally above the prior session at below-average absolute levels, adding no conviction.
claude.key_risk: This is the third breakout attempt of the same move; prior breakouts worked only 2 of 4 times, and a third push increases the probability of being the exhaustion leg.
claude.entry_note: Skip if the open gaps above the signal day's high near 70 or if the first 30 minutes show a fade back below the prior close of 68.03.
